policy.completion_rule: A capability is complete only when its computed stage reaches PRODUCTION_READY; file/class existence is never completion.
policy.exception_process: Any new capability foundation before the active epic is PRODUCTION_READY requires an explicit reviewed exception in the PR rationale.

capabilities.title: Battery Thevenin 1RC
capabilities.summary: Exact 1RC route with replay (FUNCTIONAL). Calibration PASS is SCOPED: one LG HG2 cell (SN62A4), 25 degC, pulse time scale, SOC >= 0.10, OCV measured not fitted, OCV-knot uncertainty not propagated. NASA FY08Q4 is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. Held-out: pulses pass pooled limits (fail under load alone); the 1C constant-current test fails marginally (MODEL_REJECTED by the frozen mapping). No cross-cell validation; measurement uncertainty not admitted.
next_actions: Cross-cell held-out evaluation on independent cells with measured OCV and pulse data (e.g. Kirkaldy 2024 RPTs, owner-approved download).
Decide the model scope the constant-current failure allows (pulse-scale only) under a new preregistration.
Owner/review decision on publisher-stated Type B measurement accuracy.
Propagate OCV-knot uncertainty jointly with R0/R1/C1.
Only then claims and BatteryDomainPack integration.

independent_validation.next_action: LG HG2 (one cell, 25 degC): held-out 2C/4C pulses PASS (1RC 12.6 mV) but the 1C constant-current test FAILS (28.7 mV, P95 50.7 mV): outcome MODEL_REJECTED. NASA: cross-cell transfer FAILS. Needs a cross-cell held-out evaluation on independent cells and a model scope that the constant-current test supports (or a preregistered narrower claim); no acceptance limit may move after these results.

measurement_uq.next_action: LG HG2 has a publisher-stated Type B instrument accuracy (+/-5 mV, +/-75 mA, +/-1 degC; readme), not a calibration certificate; NASA states none. Owner/review decision whether a publisher accuracy statement is admissible; until then MISSING.

parameter_uq.next_action: LG HG2: identifiable parameters with a joint window bootstrap (CV 1-9 %) propagated to +/-1-2 mV; the measured OCV knots' own +/-5 mV accuracy is not yet propagated, and the band covers only 23 % of held-out pulse samples (model form dominates). Propagate OCV-knot uncertainty jointly before this can PASS.

numerical_uq.rationale: The current constant-current 1RC state transition is closed form; no discretization solver is used in this kernel.

model_discrepancy.next_action: Held-out residuals are 41-79x the parameter band and autocorrelated (lag-1 0.76-0.92): structured model-form error that cannot be separated while measurement uncertainty is UNKNOWN. Never zero.

claims_integration.next_action: Only after calibration and validation pass. Before any claim wiring, bind the parameter set's temperature and current range to a calibration record digest (today it is caller-declared and decides IN_DOMAIN), and never auto-strengthen verdicts.

domainpack_integration.next_action: Promote 1RC into BatteryDomainPack only after formal model/realization and validation gates are satisfied.

capabilities.title: NAFEMS P18.T3 thermal benchmark

next_actions: Normalize thermal/thermal_models ownership.
Create ThermalDomainPack without changing scientific authority.
Re-run benchmark and provenance regression after normalization.

real_data.rationale: This capability is a fixed external verification benchmark, not an experimental measurement workflow.

model_discrepancy.rationale: This route verifies a benchmark-specific numerical implementation rather than calibrating an empirical model against measurements.
